scope: Development ablation of cross-frame containment and local modifiers; textual entailment proxy only, never verified implementation behavior
inference_protocol: hanlp-srl-smoke-v1.json; same assets/environment, CPU4threads, two passes, input batches4, offline weights-only, exact unused NER buffer exception
selection: All newly authored controls. Freeze rules before parser outputs; same researcher authors rules and references, not independent or blind test data.
target_matching: Use explicit query predicate surface forms, casefolded exact PRED text; no gold or sentence-ID access. Exactly one matching frame required, otherwise abstain. Query identifies only action, not actor/object; all predicates in each case intentionally use a single target entity pair. Not a general capability matcher.
flat: One target frame -> negative if direct ARGM-NEG present, otherwise positive. No claim this naive baseline is SOTA.
containment_gate: Abstain if target PRED span is contained by any non-PRED argument span of another frame; no predicate-word exceptions or frame-order assumptions
modifier_gate: Abstain if target frame contains any ARGM-ADV, ARGM-MOD or ARGM-CND. Deliberately broad; manner and other assertive modifiers may lose coverage
controls: any_multiframe abstains whenever sentence has >1 frame; all_abstain is floor. All arms share same model outputs and target matching. No tuning after observed scores.
references: positive=unconditional positive target proposition supported by stated developer interpretation; negative=unconditional negative; unknown=neither. Statements in corpus are premises for a text-only test, not source truth. Missing output is abstention, not negative evidence. Preserve reference rationale and disputed cases.
metrics: Per arm and family: answered/total coverage, correct/answered selective accuracy, wrong/answered error, correct/total unconditional accuracy, positive predictions on unknown (promotion), abstained positive cases (lost positives), no-match/ambiguous target. No accuracy awarded for abstention; all-abstain accuracy undefined. Pairwise newly withheld correct/wrong/unknown decisions. No risk improvement claim without noting coverage; no equal-coverage or statistical superiority claim.
checks: gate arms never add answers to flat
stop: Complete all frozen conditions; record counterexamples, no rule repair using new results. Next work selected from observed failures, not automatic promotion to production.
